O.outcome_detail: frequency of prompt-label use and terminological fragmentation

cells.quote: We identified 283 distinct prompt labels, most of which were used in only one publication.
cells.note: The study reports bibliometric label frequencies rather than an instructional treatment effect.

D.treatment: Tailored focused lung ultrasound training program

cells.quote: The GPs obtained LUS-OSAUS scores between 96% to 100% of max. score (median = 99%).
cells.note: All participating GPs received the training; no pre-training or control comparison was reported.

D.treatment: Tailored focused lung ultrasound training program

O.outcome_detail: Acceptable-or-higher FLUS image quality in clinical practice

cells.quote: FLUS image quality was rated acceptable or higher in 84 (92.4%) of patients (Figure 2).
cells.note: Clinical performance was assessed after training without a control or pre-training comparison.

D.treatment: GP interpretation of FLUS after training

O.outcome_detail: Agreement on presence of pathological FLUS findings

cells.quote: The GPs reported FLUS pathological findings in 51.7% of patients in 78% agreement with the Specialist Reference and Cohen’s kappa 0.56.
cells.note: This was an agreement comparison, not a randomized treatment comparison; the study describes the agreement as moderate.

result.effect: Follow-up initiated in 36/89 (40.4%); hospitalisation in 7/89 (7.9%); complication in 1/89 (1.1%)

cells.quote: The GPs initiated follow-up, such as for example re-consultation, phone call, repeated FLUS or blood tests, in 36 (40.4%) of the 89 patients with 28-day follow-up data available. Twenty patients (22.5%) had other imaging than FLUS performed during the follow-up period and four patients (4.5%) were referred for secondary sector ambulatory care. The seven patients (7.9%) who were hospitalised during follow-up and the one patient (1.1%) developing a complication, all had antibiotics prescribed at index consultation.
cells.note: The 28-day audit was observational and had no non-FLUS comparison group.
